approval.inherited_approval: 54.0 mm width, frozen Sterkrader Strasse 24 address and 0.6 mm tool-4 relief were approved by Stefan on 2026-09-04 and are unchanged

placement.anchor_rule: The frozen address point marks the WEST edge of the artwork; the marker extends east from it. Centred placement put 248 mm2 of the 54 mm logo silhouette directly on Tegeler See, whose whole mapped area is 279 mm2 in context_outline and 429 mm2 in boundary_crop, so no aperture clearance value could free the lake. The address lies 678 m east of the lake shore, therefore a west-edge anchor is the smallest displacement that keeps the approved 54.0 mm width, the approved address and an open Tegeler See.
placement.seam_clearance_change_reason: The east shift consumes seam clearance. Achieved values are 23.37 mm in context_outline and 41.94 mm in boundary_crop. The marker still lies wholly inside the left half and never crosses or touches the permanent centre seam, so the functional requirement is met; only the cosmetic 50 mm margin is relaxed. This requires human re-approval.

viewing_intent.physical_acceptance: A human reviewer recognizes the metriMade logo at 2.0 m under ordinary indoor lighting on the process-matched Oak/Sky Blue coupon.

aperture_clearance.reason: Functional support ring for a 0.6 mm raised relief with a 0.9 mm minimum stroke: five extrusion widths at the 0.4 mm nozzle. The previous 12.0 mm was a generic guard and deleted 821.4 mm2 of water in context_outline and 552.3 mm2 in boundary_crop.

parameter_contract.address_or_coordinate: Changing the address or coordinate regenerates only marker placement after a frozen geocode and keep-out check.
parameter_contract.artwork_asset: Changing the logo/image/icon regenerates only the marker silhouette after rights, aspect-ratio and minimum-feature checks.
parameter_contract.width_mm: Artwork width remains independent from map scale; revision 0.5.1 uses the human-approved 54.0 mm value for the 600 x 400 mm Berlin product.
parameter_contract.relief_height_mm: Marker relief is process-controlled and is not scaled with the map.
parameter_contract.semantic_tool: The marker reuses one of the four existing tools; it must not create a fifth filament assignment.
parameter_contract.anchor: The anchor selects which artwork edge or centre coincides with the frozen address point. Changing it regenerates only marker placement after keep-out, seam-clearance and water checks.
